program.merge_policy: accumulate twenty 25-entry deep passes; consolidate and validate once after Wave 2500

source_provenance: Direct PubMed/PMC abstract and public record verification
Regular web research used when NCBI endpoint rate-limited
manual result-direction, population, formulation, route, evidence-quality, and safety calibration

policy.validation_strategy: deep source calibration per pass; expensive repository-wide validation after Wave 2500

waves.title: Dietary Magnesium Intake in Relation to Depression in Adults: A GRADE-Assessed Systematic Review and Dose-Response Meta-analysis of Epidemiologic Studies.
waves.study: systematic review/dose-response meta-analysis of epidemiologic studies
waves.population: 63,214 adults across cross-sectional and cohort studies
waves.finding: Higher dietary magnesium intake was associated with lower depression risk, with an approximately 7% lower risk per 100 mg/day increment in pooled observational analyses.
waves.safety: Observational dietary-intake associations do not establish that magnesium supplements prevent or treat depression.

waves.title: Curcumin Versus Corticosteroids for Symptomatic Oral Lichen Planus: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
waves.population: 499 people with symptomatic oral lichen planus
waves.finding: Curcumin improved pain more than corticosteroids at one week, but pain differences were not significant at later follow-ups and lesion outcomes were broadly comparable.
waves.safety: Clinical formulations and routes varied and risk of bias/heterogeneity limit claims about generic oral curcumin supplements.

waves.title: Evaluation of glycine treatment for reducing alcohol craving and self-administration in individuals with alcohol use disorder: A human laboratory trial.
waves.finding: Five days of oral glycine did not reduce alcohol self-administration, craving, or most subjective alcohol effects versus placebo.
waves.safety: Useful direct human null evidence; short exposure and laboratory drinking do not address longer-term clinical treatment outcomes.

waves.title: The Impact of Metformin on Vitamin B12 Levels in Children and Adolescents: A Systematic Review and Single-Arm Meta-Analysis.
waves.finding: Vitamin B12 concentrations tended to decline with longer metformin exposure; pooled deficiency prevalence was low in randomized trials but substantially higher and heterogeneous in observational cohorts.
waves.safety: This is medication-associated nutrient-status evidence, not proof that routine B12 supplementation is necessary for every pediatric metformin user.

waves.title: Vitamin D supplementation in infertile men: a systematic review and meta-analysis of effects on semen quality and endocrine function.
waves.study: systematic review/meta-analysis of 11 studies including 8 RCTs
waves.finding: Vitamin D supplementation produced small improvements in semen volume, sperm concentration, progressive motility, and testosterone, but clinical pregnancy and live-birth outcomes were not significantly improved.
waves.safety: No serious vitamin-D-related adverse events were reported, but fertility surrogate improvements should not be equated with proven live-birth benefit.

waves.title: Vitamin D Pretreatment to Prevent the Risk of Postoperative Hypocalcemic Complications After Parathyroidectomy in Primary Hyperparathyroidism: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
waves.study: systematic review/meta-analysis of 3 RCTs and 6 cohort studies
waves.population: 2,750 people undergoing parathyroidectomy for primary hyperparathyroidism
waves.finding: Preoperative vitamin D was associated with lower postoperative hypocalcemia and symptomatic hypocalcemia risk and a modestly shorter hospital stay.
waves.safety: Low-quality, perioperative disease-specific evidence should not be generalized to routine supplementation in otherwise healthy adults.

waves.title: Does previous pregnancy experience improve folic acid supplementation uptake? A systematic review and meta-analysis.
waves.finding: Multiparous women were less likely than first-time mothers to use folic acid before or around conception, with an even larger gap in some high-risk groups.
waves.safety: This describes supplementation behavior, not folic-acid efficacy or dose-response.

waves.title: Consuming grass finished lamb improves blood plasma ω-3 fatty acid response among healthy consumers.
waves.finding: Eating grass-finished lamb for four weeks increased plasma ALA, EPA, and DPA relative to concentrate-finished lamb, without clear changes in measured cardiovascular risk factors.
waves.safety: This is whole-food matrix evidence and should not be represented as evidence for omega-3 supplement efficacy.

waves.title: The Route of Administration Determines the Efficacy of Zinc in Preventing Radiation-Induced Oral Mucositis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
waves.finding: Zinc reduced severe oral mucositis overall, but benefit was driven mainly by topical zinc mouthwash; systemic oral zinc was borderline and not reliably effective.
waves.safety: Route is decisive; topical treatment evidence must not be converted into claims for oral zinc supplementation.

waves.title: Comprehensive PRISMA Based Systematic Review: Exploring the Phytochemistry, Pharmacological Profile and Clinical aspects of Panax ginseng.
waves.population: mixed mechanistic, pharmacologic, and clinical literature
waves.finding: The review summarizes ginsenoside chemistry and diverse reported pharmacologic and clinical effects but does not provide a focused quantitative efficacy synthesis for a single indication.
waves.safety: Broad narrative/systematic synthesis is useful context but insufficient for source-specific efficacy claims.

waves.title: Nutrition and dietary supplements in age-related macular degeneration.
waves.finding: The review supports defined AREDS-type formulations for reducing progression from intermediate to advanced AMD, while evidence for individual nutrients such as lutein, zeaxanthin, zinc, and omega-3 varies by context.
waves.safety: Benefits apply to specific AREDS formulations and disease stages, not arbitrary combinations or general eye-health supplementation.

waves.title: Interactions Between Nutraceuticals and α-Synuclein Conformational States: Molecular Mechanisms and Neuroprotective Implications in Parkinson's Disease.
waves.finding: Multiple nutraceutical classes may alter alpha-synuclein aggregation or related oxidative/inflammatory pathways, but clinical translation is limited by bioavailability, blood-brain-barrier exposure, and sparse human efficacy evidence.
waves.safety: Mechanistic activity does not establish clinical neuroprotection in Parkinson disease.

waves.title: EFFICACY OF MELATONIN AS AN ADJUNCT TO NONSURGICAL PERIODONTAL THERAPY: A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW AND META-ANALYSIS.
waves.finding: Adjunctive melatonin improved clinical attachment at several follow-ups and probing depth at earlier follow-ups, while bleeding on probing was not clearly improved; prediction intervals crossed the null for key periodontal outcomes.
waves.safety: Melatonin was tested alongside periodontal therapy, so independent supplement efficacy cannot be inferred; heterogeneity was substantial.

waves.title: Therapeutic Effects of Probiotics on Symptoms of Anxiety in Children and Adolescents: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Placebo-Controlled Trials.
waves.finding: Probiotics did not significantly reduce anxiety overall; a small neurodevelopmental-disorder subgroup suggested possible benefit but was based on limited studies.
waves.safety: Pediatric, strain-specific and subgroup evidence does not support a broad probiotic anxiolytic claim.

waves.title: The effects of protein supplementation on body composition after bariatric surgery: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
waves.finding: Protein supplementation modestly favored body weight, muscle mass, fat-free mass, and fat mass, while BMI and some lean-mass measures were not significantly changed; certainty ranged from moderate to low.
waves.safety: Post-bariatric nutritional management is a special clinical context and should not be generalized to routine protein supplementation.

waves.title: The Role of Omega-3 Polyunsaturated Fatty Acid Supplementation in Postoperative Recovery of Colorectal Cancer: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
waves.finding: Omega-3-containing perioperative nutrition improved several nutritional, immune, and inflammatory markers and was associated with shorter hospitalization and fewer infectious or surgical complications, without a mortality benefit.
waves.safety: Clinical nutrition formulations and postoperative care context prevent direct translation to routine consumer fish-oil dosing.

waves.title: Probiotics and aging: Impacts on cognitive function, brain-derived neurotrophic factor, inflammation, and antioxidant activity. A systematic review and meta-analysis.
waves.population: older adults, generally age 50 and above
waves.finding: Probiotics modestly improved pooled global cognition and some cognitive domains and altered selected BDNF, inflammatory, and oxidative-stress markers, with substantial heterogeneity.
waves.safety: Strain composition varied and biomarker changes do not establish a uniform cognitive benefit for all probiotic products.

waves.title: Resistance training combined with creatine supplementation: a three-level meta-analysis of multidimensional outcomes from strength enhancement to body composition remodeling.
waves.finding: Creatine added to resistance training improved upper- and lower-body strength and modestly increased lean mass while slightly reducing body-fat percentage; fat mass itself was not significantly reduced.
waves.safety: Moderator findings were exploratory and do not establish a single optimal regimen across ages or training contexts.

waves.title: Effects of Probiotic and Synbiotic Supplementation on Metabolic and Hepatic Outcomes in Children and Adolescents With Obesity, Including Those With Obesity-Related Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
waves.finding: Probiotic/synbiotic interventions modestly lowered total cholesterol, LDL-C, and ALT but did not clearly improve BMI-z, waist circumference, triglycerides, HDL-C, or fasting glucose; pooled HOMA-IR unexpectedly increased.
waves.safety: Outcome inconsistency and strain heterogeneity argue against a broad metabolic-benefit claim.

waves.title: Meta-analysis of the Effects of Probiotics on Alcoholic Liver Disease.
waves.finding: Probiotics reduced ALT and showed a borderline AST reduction but did not clearly improve bilirubin, albumin, or GGT; subgroup results varied by region, sex distribution, and duration.
waves.safety: Clinical liver-disease context and strain heterogeneity limit general probiotic claims.

waves.title: The mechanism of probiotics in pregnancy outcomes in overweight or obese pregnant women based on meta-analysis, network pharmacology and molecular docking.
waves.study: meta-analysis of 8 RCTs plus network-pharmacology/molecular-docking analyses
waves.population: 1,563 pregnant women with overweight or obesity
waves.finding: Probiotics did not significantly improve adverse pregnancy outcomes overall; a subgroup using Bifidobacterium plus Lactobacillus showed lower small-for-gestational-age risk.
waves.safety: The subgroup signal is hypothesis-generating and should not be generalized across strains or pregnancy populations.

waves.title: An updated systematic review and appraisal of the pathophysiologic mechanisms of probiotics in alleviating depression.
waves.population: people with depressive symptoms or disorders
waves.finding: Probiotics reduced pooled depressive-symptom scores, including HAM-D, but heterogeneity was high and multi-strain interventions appeared more consistently positive than single strains.
waves.safety: Mechanistic explanations remain provisional and product-level efficacy depends on strain composition.

waves.title: Topical curcumin in the treatment of denture stomatitis: a systematic review of clinical efficacy.
waves.finding: Topical curcumin delivered as mouthwash, ointment, or photodynamic adjunct reduced Candida burden and clinical signs in included trials.
waves.safety: Evidence is explicitly topical and cannot support oral curcumin-supplement claims; certainty was only moderate.

waves.title: The therapeutic potential of N-acetylcysteine across multiple organ systems: a narrative review.
waves.finding: The review summarizes NAC's established mucolytic and acetaminophen-antidote uses plus broader antioxidant and anti-inflammatory research across organ systems, without providing a focused quantitative efficacy estimate for a new indication.
waves.safety: Useful background context but insufficient for new source-specific efficacy promotion.

waves.title: Safety and efficacy of liposomal iron for iron deficiency anemia in pediatric population: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
waves.finding: Liposomal iron produced broadly similar hematologic responses to conventional iron, with a later hemoglobin advantage at six months and fewer overall adverse events and constipation.
waves.safety: Small evidence base, substantial heterogeneity, pediatric population, and formulation specificity prevent generalization to all iron products.
